column4: This is an independent analysis compiled from public sources.
The sources are BlackRock product pages, SEC filings, procurement notices, public code and packages on GitHub and PyPI, press releases, job postings, and transcripts of BlackRock recordings.
BlackRock did not produce, review or endorse it.
Facts are as of October 19, 2026, unless an exhibit gives another date.
AI agents pulled the pages, unpacked the packages, transcribed the recordings and drafted the text.
I checked each claim against the document or recording it cites.
Underlined text links to the document behind each fact.
Superscripts point to the Sources section, which follows this page
